about.title: About Me
about.description: Hello! I am Rachmad Aziz Fazarikha, a passionate Fullstack Web Developer and an undergraduate Information Systems student at Universitas Trunojoyo Madura. Over the past 4 years of exploring the technology industry, I have developed a deep interest in building dynamic, efficient, and user-centric web applications from the ground up.
about.description2: I am highly motivated by the challenge of turning complex problems into streamlined digital solutions. By leveraging modern frameworks, I continuously seek to enhance my projects and am always eager to implement my knowledge into impactful, real-world applications that make a difference.
